jobs.description:
Starte jetzt. Gestalte morgen. BFuture.


Du denkst gerne vernetzt, interessierst dich für Wirtschaft, Daten und digitale Technologien? Dann ist die Lehrstelle als Entwickler:in Digitales Business EFZ bei Bühler genau das Richtige für dich!


Bewerbe dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse) und starte deine Zukunft mit uns! Aufgaben: • Du arbeitest in Projekten mit und berätst verschiedene Stakeholder • Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und ICT-Produkte und entwickelst Optimierungsvorschläge • Du koordinierst Arbeitsschritte und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung der Projekte • Du analysierst und wertest Daten aus und bereitest diese verständlich auf • Du erstellst Visualisierungen und Präsentationen, verfolgst Trends und überprüfst sowie bewertest Ergebnisse Anforderungen: • Interesse an technischen Trends • Freude an Kommunikation und überzeugendem Präsentieren • Freude am Analysieren und vernetzten Denken • Gute Sprachkenntnisse (DE, EN) • Zuverlässigkeit, Kundenorientierung und Teamfähigkeit Wir bieten: Attraktiver Ferienanspruch Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr. Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze. Personalrestaurant VIVA Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF. Handy-Abonnements Wir bieten Spezialkonditionen bei Handyabonnements über Mobilezone bei Sunrise und Swisscom. Health-Port Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein. Sportangebote Wir fördern die sportliche Betätigung durch eigenorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie durch Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Allora l'apprendistato come sviluppatore: in Digital Business EFZ a Bühler è esattamente la cosa giusta per voi! Applicare ora con i documenti di applicazione completi (lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati) e iniziare il tuo futuro con noi! Compiti:
• Lavori in progetti e consiglia vari stakeholder
• Analizzerai i processi aziendali e i prodotti ICT e svilupperai proposte di ottimizzazione
• Coordinate le fasi di lavoro e sostenete l'attuazione dei progetti
• Analizzi e raccogli dati e lo prepari comprensibilmente
• È possibile creare visualizzazioni e presentazioni, tracciare tendenze e rivedere e valutare i risultati Requisiti
• Interessi delle tendenze tecniche
• Gioia della comunicazione e presentazione convincente
• Gioia di analisi e pensiero in rete
• Buone competenze linguistiche (DE, EN)
• Affidabilità, orientamento del cliente e lavoro di squadra Offriamo: Attraente diritto di vacanza Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito. Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF. Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom. Porta salute Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Attività sportive Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Start now. Design tomorrow. BFuture.

You like to think connected, are you interested in business, data and digital technologies? Then the apprenticeship as a developer: in Digital Business EFZ at Bühler is exactly the right thing for you!


Apply now with your complete application documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates) and start your future with us! Tasks: • You work in projects and advise various stakeholders • You will analyze business processes and ICT products and develop optimization proposals • You coordinate work steps and support the implementation of the projects • You analyze and harvest data and prepare it understandably • You create visualizations and presentations, track trends and review and evaluate results Requirements • Interest in technical trends • Joy of communication and convincing presentation • Joy of analyzing and networked thinking • Good language skills (DE, EN) • Reliability, customer orientation and teamwork We offer: Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a Solution Architect SAP C4C v2 to shape our global CRM landscape based on SAP Sales Cloud v2 and SAP Service Cloud v2. As the architectural lead, you will design scalable and integrated solutions that support Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Digital Customer Experience processes, while ensuring seamless connectivity across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and other enterprise platforms. Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and development teams, you will drive architectural decisions, govern technology standards, and help define the future roadmap of our customer engagement ecosystem.

Aufgaben:
• You define and drive the target architecture for Bühler's global CRM platform and Customer Engagement ecosystem

• You design scalable integration and data solutions across SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and connected digital platforms

• You translate business and technical requirements into solution architectures, implementation roadmaps, and design guidelines

• You lead architectural governance, technical decision-making, and ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, integration, and security standards

• You collaborate closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to continuously evolve and enhance CRM capabilities

Anforderungen:
• University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification, combined with proven experience as a Solution Architect or Lead Architect in large-scale SAP CRM transformation programs

• Deep expertise in SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and SAP Integration Suite within complex global SAP environments

• Strong knowledge of enterprise integration architecture, including APIs, event-driven architectures, master data integration, customer data management, and enterprise integration patterns

• Ability to define architecture roadmaps, lead technical governance, and translate business strategy into scalable, secure, and future-oriented solution designs

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience working in Agile (SAFe) environments and influencing business and technology decisions at senior leadership level

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about securing digital identities and shaping the future of enterprise security architecture? As part of our continued investment in Cyber Security and Identity & Access Management (IAM), we are building a new IAM Product team and are looking for an experienced IAM Architect to help shape this capability further. In this newly created role, you will have the unique opportunity to define architectural standards, influence strategic direction, and build the foundation for scalable and secure identity services across our global organization.

Aufgaben:
• You design, govern, and continuously evolve enterprise-wide Identity & Access Management architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and security requirements

• You define IAM standards, policies, and architecture principles for authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access management, and identity governance

• You design secure identity and access concepts for employees, partners, service accounts, APIs, and privileged users while ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements

• You act as a trusted advisor for business and technology teams, driving secure-by-design IAM solutions and supporting the integration of new applications, platforms, and services

• You assess identity-related risks, conduct security and architecture reviews, contribute to incident response activities, and collaborate closely with Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Compliance, and external partners

Anforderungen:
• Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security, or a related field, combined with 5+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management within complex enterprise environments

• Strong expertise across IAM disciplines including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, role design, federation, and Privileged Access Management (PAM)

• Hands-on experience with leading IAM and Identity Governance platforms such as Sailpoint, Omada, One Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and PAM solutions

• Proven track record integrating enterprise platforms and applications, including SAP and Microsoft ecosystems, into IAM and Identity Governance processes

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, and NIS2, combined with fluency in English

• Curiosity about AI and a willingness to explore how it can be applied responsibly in day-to-day project controlling work to improve analysis, reporting, data quality, and efficiency

• Advanced Excel skills as well as knowledge of SAP FI/CO; experience with SAP BW and SAP BusinessObjects reporting and dashboards are an advantage

• Fluency in written and spoken English, combined with the ability to prepare, analyze, and present data for reporting and management communication

- Ottime capacità comunicative in tedesco e inglese, idealmente integrate da conoscenze del francese
- Buona comprensione dei processi di vendita, nonché del coordinamento e della collaborazione con diverse parti interessate

- Abbonamenti di telefonia mobile
Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti di telefonia mobile tramite Mobilezone con Sunrise e Swisscom.

Informazioni su Bühler

Due miliardi di persone mangiano ogni giorno alimenti prodotti su impianti Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggia in veicoli i cui componenti sono stati prodotti utilizzando tecnologie Bühler.

Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità commerciali sostenibili nei settori globali dell'industria alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità.

Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione a soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Per questo collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere insieme un impatto più rapido.

Description

As a Customer Relations Manager, it is your task to build a trusting and reliable partnership with our customers, establish Bühler as a service provider and offer our customers our diverse range of service offerings. You support customers in increasing the productivity and service life of their machines and systems and thus in becoming even more successful. Are you a proactive, business-oriented and empathetic personality with a very good technical and commercial understanding? Are you extremely successful in building and maintaining close customer relationships? Then become part of our Customer Service Team!

Responsibilities

- You will be responsible for managing and developing existing customer relationships through customer visits, consultations and ensuring the agreed services, as well as through a keen interest in customer challenges and an understanding of decision-making processes and criteria
- You are responsible for the active sale of sophisticated service products such as service contracts, spare parts, conversions and service projects, communicating the customer benefits in a targeted and convincing manner
- You will systematically develop the market in your sales territory, further develop existing customers, identify and acquire new customers and contribute to winning back former customers
- You are responsible for achieving sales and revenue targets through the sustainable expansion and further development of the service business, as well as for the professional control and management of the entire sales process in the CRM system
- You will work closely with back-office teams and competence centers on customer inquiries and actively contribute to defining and implementing the Customer Service strategy in the sales territory, as well as the corporate strategy

Requirements

- Technical training with further commercial education, as well as experience in selling sophisticated technical products and service solutions
- Strong customer orientation, pronounced negotiating skills, as well as an interest in customer needs and sustainable customer relationships
- Very good communication skills in German and English, ideally complemented by knowledge of French
- Good understanding of sales processes, as well as of coordinating and collaborating with various stakeholders
- Motivated, independent, team-oriented and entrepreneurial personality with a high willingness to travel of 60-80 % in the sales territory

- VIVA staff restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.
- Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit, as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking spaces.
- Health port
We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional counseling, physiotherapy, group courses and an occupational physician.

Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 up to 30 vacation days per year depending on age.
- Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

We offer special rates on mobile phone subscriptions through Mobilezone with Sunrise and Swisscom.

About Bühler

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced on Bühler equipment. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.

With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of bringing the needs of business, people and nature into harmony. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
